description: Verifies the finite-difference connection solver at fourth, sixth and eighth order against the analytic connection of Minkowski and Schwarzschild spacetimes: exactness on flat space, lower-index symmetry, error ordering across stencil orders, dispatch to the analytic connection and the numerical wrapper, without dynamic allocation.

checks.label: the fourth-order connection of Minkowski vanishes
the sixth-order connection of Minkowski vanishes
the eighth-order connection of Minkowski vanishes
the dispatching solver returns the vanishing analytic connection of Minkowski
the numerical connection is symmetric in its lower indices for every stencil order
the fourth-order connection agrees with the analytic one within a relative 1e-6
the sixth-order connection agrees with the analytic one within a relative 1e-9
the eighth-order connection agrees with the analytic one within a relative 1e-12
the eighth-order connection agrees with the analytic one within an absolute 1e-12
the sixth-order relative error never exceeds the fourth-order relative error
the dispatching solver returns exactly the analytic connection when the metric provides one
the numerical metric wrapper reproduces the analytic connection within a relative 1e-12
no dynamic allocation occurs in the connection solver
